headline: The United States and China are competing to set the AI agenda before talks between China's President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen, the South China Morning Post reports, citing sources.
score_reason: Lowered from 7: only the headline could be read and the report rests on unnamed sources.
importance_line: If accurate, AI rules and cooperation may be on the table at a top-level US-China meeting, which would matter to governments and AI companies in both countries, but the details are unverified.
summary: The South China Morning Post reports, citing unnamed sources, that Washington and Beijing are both trying to shape the AI agenda ahead of talks between China's President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen.
notes: Headline only; the article was blocked and no other outlet carried the exclusive.
